people.name: Jennifer Brisman
bio: Jennifer is the Founder and CEO of VOW, an innovative technology company building the future of live events globally. A 20+ year Event Industry Expert, Jennifer is proud to have produced over 600 live events touching nearly 60M in contracts. During the first leg of her career, Jennifer became known for championing financial and creative efficiencies by implementing centralized workflows across live event teams, partners and clients. Jennifer has been featured in CNN, The New York Times, Wall Street Journal, NBC, Forbes, Thrive Global, Skift, BizBash, Sports Business Journal and Yahoo Finance, just to name a few. During the pandemic, the first iteration of VOW, dubbed VOW Digital Health, facilitated and ‘safed’ over 1.5B in event revenue across over 500 events for many of the world’s biggest brands like Uber and Peloton.

Jennifer is immensely passionate about supporting women in business and technology. She is a portfolio company of Techstars Sports powered by Indy and an active member of Good for Her championed by HBS alum and former Digital Ocean CTO, Julia Austin. Prior, she was an active member of Chief (2020-2024), Betaworks Circles (2020), Female Founder Collective by Rebecca Minkoff (2020-2022), Dream Ventures by Annie Evans (2021-2022) and Bolster (2023).

people.name: Justin Morris
bio: Justin has over 20 years of success working for finance, multimedia and technology firms and 2 exits. A serial builder, Justin has served as Founder, CEO and COO of various tech companies, overseeing product development from ideation through launch. He has produced and developed content for some of the largest companies in the industry including FOX, NBC, The Discovery Channel and E! He founded Azimyth Creation Studio which was a pioneer in the Virtual Reality industry and the first company to film a US president in VR. With FTI Consulting, Justin leveraged his financial acumen where he facilitated the restructure of over $40 billion of assets for various F1000 companies. Most recently, Justin disrupted the Cannabis delivery industry with the first Compliant Cannabis logistics software sold to Weedmaps.

people.name: Andy Bromberg
bio: Andy is considered one of the most forward-thinking entrepreneurs today. He is currently the Chairman of ECO after serving as CEO from 2020-2024. Prior, Andy was the Co-Founder, Founding CEO and President of CoinList, the global leader in token issuance. He was also the Founder and CEO of Sidewire, a mobile-based political news analysis platform curated by leading political journalists and operatives.

people.name: Ryan Harwood
bio: Ryan Harwood is the CEO of Gallery Media Group, a media holding company focused on building media brands that truly matter to the end consumer through distinct editorial missions, voice, and aesthetic. Their assets include women’s lifestyle brand PureWow, which has grown to become a top digital publisher for women reaching over 100M women monthly. PureWow has been honored with awards such as Inc. 500 Fastest Growing Companies, Forbes America's Most Promising Companies, and Forbes Top 100 Best Websites for Women. Other assets include ONE37pm, Royally Obsessed and ONE37pm: Live from the Bar Cart, The Gallery Instagram Portfolio, The Coterie & The Roster and The Gallery Podcast Co. Ryan steered the ship through a highly successful acquisition by Gary Vaynerchuk and Steve Ross in 2017.

people.name: Alexandra Wilkis Wilson
bio: Alexandra is an American entrepreneur and investor who co-founded the companies the Gilt Groupe, GlamSquad, and Fitz. She is currently Co-Founder and Managing Partner at Clerisy, the growth equity fund which she co-founded with Lisa Myers, formerly a partner at L. Catterton and a 20-year veteran of Templeton. Clerisy's growing portfolio includes investments in Dormify, UNION and CleanCo. Alexandra is an advisor and angel investor to over 80 tech startups including Birchbox, Carbon 38, Rent the Runway and Tula. She has been an advisor to consumer tech Venture Capital funds including Forerunner Ventures and Montage Ventures.

people.name: Dave Brown
bio: Dave is a veteran private equity and venture investor with over twenty years of experience in a huge range of sectors. Past and current investments include Pinterest, Plenty United, Ladder Life, Tell, Sipree, Cargo Chief and OpenFin. Dave’s strength is working with founders and entrepreneurs to turn great ideas into successful growing businesses.

people.name: Ishviene Arora
bio: Ishviene Arora, named PR & Marketing Executive of the Year for 2018 by Business Intelligence Group, has over 15 years of experience in integrated communications. She has managed campaigns for some of the largest financial institutions worldwide, including Citigroup, RBC, Bloomberg and Morgan Stanley. Prior, she was the Director at financial PR firm, Cognito for over 10 years and prior to that was at Investor Relations firm, Taylor Rafferty. In 2014 Ishviene was awarded the Bulldog Reporter’s PR Gold Award for Financial Communications Professional of the Year.

people.name: Melody Finkelstein
people.role: Fmr. Vice President of Research at Kohlberg and Co.
bio: Melody Finkelstein is a financial professional with experience across Private Equity, Investment Banking, Corporate Finance and Operations. She also previously founded and managed a shoe manufacturing business based in New York City. Melody received a B.S. in Business Administration from Georgetown University.

people.name: Andrew Goldman
people.role: Co-Chair, Bankruptcy and Financial Restructuring Practice Group, Wilmer Hale
bio: Andrew is co-chair of Wilmer’s Bankruptcy and Financial Restructuring Practice Group, resident in the New York office. He champions bankruptcy-related litigation and corporate issues. Having practiced in the field for more than 25 years, Mr. Goldman is a seasoned bankruptcy litigator and counselor whose practical insights and analytical abilities enable him to fashion strategy and form consensus in the most complicated of restructuring environments.

people.name: Christina Matteucci
bio: Executive Director of David Beahm Experiences, Christina Matteucci pioneers an integral role within the special event industry running operations and design for celebrity designer David Beahm. Christina has spent two decades skillfully executing unfathomably complex soirées all over the globe, managing experiences and operations for the biggest clients in the world. A highly respected voice both here in the US and internationally, Christina is a TEDx alum and often a Keynote Speaker at the most important and impactful event industry conferences.

people.name: Ryan Hill
bio: Apotheosis Events, led by CEO Ryan Hill, is a premier event-planning firm serving international clientele and their pursuits in entertainment, weddings, finance, media, philanthropy, and global consumer products. Ryan has been celebrated for prominent work including premieres, product launches, award shows, and milestone social occasions for an elite clientele. Ryan has been trusted by names such as The Rolling Stones, Hawaiian Airlines, Ambassador Theatre Group, Reynolda House Museum of American Art, and Samsung. Apotheosis was honored to produce the US premiere of the juggernaut Harry Potter and the Cursed Child, as well as events for John Hardy and the world premiere of Fosse/Verdon for FX Network. In addition to working with Fortune 100 brands, Apotheosis has orchestrated for Cher, Sting, Denzel Washington, Sally Field, Amy Schumer, Scarlett Johansson, Michelle Williams, Jeff Bridges, and Lin-Manuel Miranda.
